slots.label: HEAD
slots.blurb: The most visible slot in the game. This is where drip is read from across a room.

items.d: Just your head, out in the weather.
Curved brim, no logo, been through a wash it shouldn't have.
Still smells faintly of a classroom.
Pulled down to the eyebrows. Standard issue.
Flat brim, sits high, says nothing about you.
Half fisherman, half nuisance. Fully anonymous.
Zipped to the nose. Nobody sees your face and nobody asks.
Ridiculous in April. Unbeatable in January.
Nobody suspects a cyclist. Everybody hates a cyclist.
Site Kit piece. Grants entry to places doors don't.
Softens your whole face. Weaponised harmlessness.
Legal to wear. Legal to wear indoors, technically.
Nobody's ever asked a nurse what she's doing here.
Puts your face in permanent shadow. Costs you every conversation.
Sunday Best piece. You look like you own something.
Full face, dark visor. Illegal in most shops and every bank.
Grey Man piece. Forgettable by design and by law of averages.
Two problems solved. Two more created.
Straight out the box. Somebody will comment.
He gave it to you without saying why. Unsellable.
Level 100. Nobody wears this by accident.
Seasonal. When it's gone it's gone.

slots.label: FACE
slots.blurb: The trade-off slot. Everything here helps you work and hurts you socially.

items.d: Your actual face. Cameras love it.
Pulled up in winter. Nobody blinks.
Half a scarf doing a full-time job.
Nobody's questioned one of these since 2020.
Says exactly what you're doing. Loudly.
Cuts your face out of the footage. And out of everything else.
Warmer. Somehow more sinister.
Site Kit piece. You're working. Obviously you're working.
Deniable. It's cold, isn't it.
Comes off in one pull. That's the feature.
Absolute overkill. Absolutely effective.
Grey Man piece. Nothing to describe to a sketch artist.
Someone put effort into a thing meant to be invisible.
You stopped hiding. Somehow that works better now.

slots.label: JACKET
slots.blurb: The statement piece. Biggest silhouette, biggest status read.

items.d: It's England. This is a mistake.
Three quid. Smells of somebody's nan.
Stops wind. Loses to rain immediately.
The uniform. Nobody looks twice.
Two stripes. Built for leaving somewhere quickly.
Stylish. Useless in February.
Warm arms are for people with time.
Two sizes too big. That's the point.
Down to the knee. Fits everything. Hides everything.
Hood up, it's a different person walking.
Countryside energy. Nobody stops a man in a wax jacket.
The most powerful item in the game and it costs forty quid.
Cuffs at the wrist, nothing catches on anything.
You've already forgotten what it looks like.
Shorter, faster, colder.
Takes a graze better than skin does.
Long, dark, respectable. Doors open.
Rustles. That's the one flaw and it's a real one.
Nobody asks a man in a blazer for ID.
Clipboard sold separately. Clipboard essential.
Everyone in the borough knows this jacket.
It still fits. That's the annoying part. Unsellable.
Grey. Enormous. Weirdly comfortable. You kept it.
Seasonal.

slots.label: TOP
slots.blurb: Under the jacket. Low visibility, so this is where pure stat items live.

items.d: Optimistic.
The most useful garment ever made.
Deliberately forgettable. That's the feature.
Tight, warm, no snag points.
Swallows you whole. Ideal.
Rooftops in January are a different job in this.
Collar. Buttons. Built for being grabbed.
Everything tucked in. Nothing to hold onto.
Sunday Best piece. Instant respectability.
Grey Man piece. Beige for people who find beige loud.
Site Kit piece. Nobody stops a man who's obviously working.
Expensive, invisible, correct.
Prison Issue piece. Washed a thousand times.
Bulk without arms. Movement without cold.
He gave you one for free. It has your name on the back. Bad idea.
Still just a vest. Now it means something.

slots.label: BOTTOMS
slots.blurb: Speed lives here. This is the running slot.

items.d: Stiff, loud, hopeless in a chase.
Swish when you walk. Everyone hears you coming.
Cuffed at the ankle. Nothing to catch on a fence.
Nine pockets. You will lose things in all nine.
Comfortable. Slow. Honest about it.
Zips that seal. Pockets that don't spill on a run.
Knee pads built in. You'll be grateful once.
Fast. Deeply undignified.
Trousers so forgettable they’re almost an alibi.
Rustle badly. Keep you moving in weather that stops others.
Creased sharp. Nobody questions a crease.
Made for coming off a bike. Which you will.
Elastic waist. No belt allowed. You know why.
Four days a year these are correct. Those days you're unstoppable.
Double-stitched everywhere that usually goes.
You are so clearly meant to be here.
Nobody outruns you in these. That's not a stat. That's a fact.
Seasonal.

slots.label: FEET
slots.blurb: The status slot. In UK street culture, trainers say more than anything else you own.

items.d: Something has gone very wrong.
Someone else broke these in. Badly.
No grip, no support, no weight either.
Held together by habit.
Light. Fast. Ruined by one puddle.
Flat, wide, grip like glue on a wall.
Chunky. Loud. Correct.
Steel toe. Doors mind them.
Made for hills. Excellent on scaffolding.
Genuinely indescribable footwear.
Click on pavement. Announce respectability.
Ruined the moment it rains. Worth it.
On and off in one motion. Underrated.
Ankle armour. You'll notice the day you need it.
Pull-on. No laces to fail at the worst moment.
Rubber, soft, dead quiet on stairs.
Never worn. Someone kept them fifteen years.
Everyone clocks them. That's the whole item.
Half a size too big. You wear them anyway. Unsellable.
Season leaderboard reward. One per city per season.

slots.label: HANDS
slots.blurb: Small stats, big utility. Half of these are tools that pretend to be clothing.

items.d: Every surface remembers you.
Ninety-eight left. Don't think about the two.
Warm. Useless for anything requiring fingers.
Warmth and dexterity, at 60% of each.
No prints, steadier grip. Every job a touch cleaner.
Site Kit piece. Grip like a vice.
Wheel never slips. You look like a lunatic on foot.
Fits in a pocket. Doesn't fit any explanation.
Padded knuckles. Deniable. Just about.
Twice as careful. Half as comfortable.
Sand in the knuckles. Technically sportswear.
Grey Man piece. Hands nobody could describe.
Someone's initials inside. You don't look at them often.
Brass. Old. Someone else’s history in your pocket.

slots.label: WEAPON
slots.blurb: Every step up in damage is a step up in what happens when you are stopped. The best weapon in the game should be a decision the player regrets at least once.

items.d: Free. Legal. Occasionally sufficient.
It was already there. That's the whole appeal.
Sounds ridiculous. Isn't.
It's a torch. It's genuinely a torch. Mostly.
A tool. Say tool. Keep saying tool.
There’s a ball in the boot. There is always a ball in the boot.
Site Kit adjacent. Free at any site. Impossible to hide.
Technically for dogs. Legally for dogs. Used for dogs once.
Pocket-sized until it very much isn't.
Persuasion, sharpened. Marks don't argue.
Folds away. The law doesn't care that it folds away.
Someone's going to ask about the garden. There is no garden.
Big blade, bigger sentence.
A statement, not a sidearm. Using it changes the game.
items.tr: endgame only, instant heat 10, district event

items.d: "Bring it back. I mean it. That’s a good wrench." Unsellable.
Someone wrote a name on it. Not yours.

slots.label: BODY
slots.blurb: Toughness slot. Also the "blocks set bonuses" trade-off slot.

items.d: Just fabric between you and everything.
A bit of bulk. A bit of warmth. A bit of help.
Pouches for everything. Looks like exactly what it is.
Site Kit piece. Also genuinely stops you falling.
Ugly with everything. You walk away from more.
Built for tarmac at speed. Handy for other things.
Halves what an ambush takes off you. Deeply uncool.
Under a shirt, invisible. Costs what a car costs.
Train in it, fight in it, regret it on a chase.
Grey Man piece. A shape, not a person.
Prison Issue piece. Institutional and indestructible.
Overkill. Beautiful, heavy, ridiculous overkill.

slots.label: BAG
slots.blurb: Carry capacity, inventory slots, and the "you look like you are carrying" trade-off.

items.d: Four pockets and optimism.
Holds everything. Convinces nobody.
The most invisible object in Britain.
Someone's name in marker inside. Not yours.
Sits tight. Doesn't swing when you run.
Big. Obvious. Everyone knows what a holdall means.
Site Kit piece. Rattles convincingly.
Straps that don’t shift. Everything stays where it was.
Sunday Best piece. You're a professional, obviously.
Grey Man piece. Nobody has ever described this bag.
The reveal-ceremony bag. Now you own one.
You're delivering something. You're always delivering something.
Still has a receipt in the side pocket from March. Unsellable.
Everything fits. Everything always fits.

slots.label: PHONE
slots.blurb: Non-gear utility slot. Gates line features rather than giving combat stats.

items.d: Screen like a windscreen. Works. Mostly.
Clean line, no trace. Sets up the lines to come.
One for the work, one for the other work.
Enough minutes to run a small county.
Costs a fortune. Worth every penny once.
The one you'd never nick from someone else.
Battery lasts a week. Contacts list is a problem. Unsellable.
Not a phone. A number. Everyone already knows it.

slots.label: CONSUMABLES
slots.blurb: Single-use. The tactical layer. Bought cheap, used at the right moment.

items.d: Tastes like a fruit that doesn't exist.
Sandwich, crisps, drink. The nation's fuel.
Small box. Restores more than it should.
Over the counter. Under the tongue.
Terrible. Effective. Both true.
Bulky. Conspicuous. Occasionally the whole job.
Aggravates any charge. Opens any door.
Requires patience you may not have.
Cheapest counter to the scariest thing in the game.
New number, new man, same problems.
Your name on a wall. Somebody will paint over it.
Single use. Ends most conversations.
Good enough for a bouncer. Not for a custody sergeant.
Loud enough to wake a street. Fast enough to matter.
Illegal to own, sell, or explain.
Frankie's number. He'll bill you for the card.
Works on everyone except Silas, who says thank you and doesn’t drink it.
Somebody owes somebody. Tonight it’s for you.

slots.label: TROPHIES
slots.blurb: No slot, no stats, cannot be sold. They exist to be looked at.

items.d: Initials and a date in 1994. Worth two hundred. You can’t sell it and you’ve stopped trying.
He said he didn't need it yet. It's still sealed.
Your name, printed by a machine. A number underneath it.
Four words on the back of a receipt. You’ve read it a lot.
Someone’s wallet. You kept the photo and left the rest on a bus.
Taken, or given. The game remembers which.
It’s a nice pen. It writes very well. You hate it.
He got a new one. You took that one too. He never found out.
You’ve always had one. She gave you another anyway.
Season 1. It says so on the base.
Every name. Every number. Yours now.
